mentions.name: Telegram LLM hobby-project assistant bot
mentions.description: A Telegram bot with an LLM backend and a Markdown knowledgebase that helps organize, track, and research long-term hobby projects. The user texts the bot to request research (e.g., which NAS setup fits given constraints), add chosen options to the plan, and ask for next steps; the bot updates and version-controls the knowledgebase so all project details stay in one place. It is also intended for personal planning, such as fitting activities into a trip itinerary.
mentions.problem: When researching a project like a home server build through ChatGPT, it is hard to keep all the little details in one place, and existing solutions do not stick to a precise plan that can be reviewed at any given moment.
mentions.source_excerpt: I started working on a simple Telegram bot with llm backend and .md knowledgebase that would help me organize, track and research my long-term hobby projects.
